title: Live Pet Health Guarantee: One Guarantee per Purchase Line
content:
**Rule.** Every live animal purchase line opens its own Live Pet Health Guarantee, and a customer may hold any number of them: there is no limit on the number of guarantees one customer holds. Guarantees are never combined. A claim covers animals of one purchase line only, and at most the number of animals one claim may cover under that line's guarantee type.

### What a purchase line's guarantee records

Each guarantee is tied to one purchase line and shows the guarantee type, the store of purchase, the species as printed on the purchase record, the number of animals bought on the line, the price paid per animal, the purchase date and time, and the covered value of the line. The guarantee is active from purchase; it becomes claimed when a claim on it is settled, or expired when its guarantee period passes without a claim.

### The rule restated

| Question | Answer under the rule |
|---|---|
| How many guarantees may one customer hold? | Any number; no limit applies. |
| Does a second purchase line of the same species join the first line's guarantee? | No. It opens its own guarantee. |
| May one claim draw on animals from two purchase lines? | No. A claim covers animals of one purchase line only. |
| How many animals of the line may one claim cover? | At most the figure for that line's guarantee type. |

### Hypothetical illustrations

- A customer buys 8 neon tetras on one line and 8 more neon tetras on a second line on another day, both under the Freshwater Fish Guarantee. The customer holds two separate guarantees. A claim about fish from the first line covers only animals of the first line; fish from the second line can only be claimed under the second line's own guarantee.
- A customer holds a Bird Guarantee for one line and a Small Animal Guarantee for another. Each stands alone: nothing claimed under one counts against, or adds to, the other.
